theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_lsc_interior_energy
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R E r : ℝ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < r → r < R → 0 ≤ E → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 h (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → (∀ Φ : Fin n → Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ i)) → (∀ i, HasCompactSupport (Φ i)) → (∀ i, tsupport (Φ i) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ h x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * Φ i x ≤ Real.sqrt E * Real.sqrt (∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, Φ i x ^ 2)) → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) r, ‖fderiv ℝ h x‖ ^ 2 ≤ E
